story.paragraph1: BNBDEVELOPMENT is the story of two guys who met during their high school years.
story.paragraph2: Our similar interest in programming brought us together quite quickly, and we started thinking about more and more joint projects. Some of these never saw the light of day, but we learned a lot from each of them and gained experience. This is how we learned and mastered the software we use.
story.paragraph3: Working together brought more and more projects. Our first major project was a complete ticket sales system for the Agora Savaria cinema in Szombathely. This was followed by the irodalomerettségi.hu site, which was developed for students preparing for exams, aimed specifically to help students prepare for the intermediate level literature exam from a new perspective. Over the years, we also started building our own servers, on which all of the above-mentioned projects currently run.
